title: Every Rank-2 Bipartite Entangled State is Projectively Steerable
summary: We prove that every rank-2 bipartite entangled state is already steerable with projective measurements, closing the first possible gap between entanglement and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen (EPR) steering. In arbitrary finite local dimensions, any rank-2 entangled state is projectively steerable in at least one direction; when the effective dimensions are equal, steering is two-way. The argument is geometric: a rank obstruction forces some projective outcome on the larger local system to reach the boundary of the trusted-state space.
